title: Dressipi colloquial headline flat

change.control: Standard Dressipi homepage headline with Sign up now CTA.
change.variant: Use a riskier, colloquial headline reflecting prospects’ casual and self-deprecating language about their bodies; keep the original CTA.

quote: we saw a lift of about 15% that held throughout the test… but that never reached confidence
notes: Approximate point estimate; later passage calls the same estimate less than 15%. This is the initial headline-only test, not the later 123.9% headline-plus-button win. Fashion recommendation signup is the measured lead action, not clothing purchases.
